summary: Harmonic exciter, the successor of Oomek Exciter: up to four Linkwitz–Riley bands, each driven through an oversampled, anti-aliased shaper (tape, tube, transistor, diode, or warm: even harmonics only), and only the harmonics it makes (the shaper's output minus the audio) are added back, by an Amount per band. A band at 0 % is left alone, bit for bit. A high shelf on the added harmonics, optional auto gain, left/right or mid/side, Delta (hear only what it adds) and a gain-match reading. Use it for air and presence on masters, vocals and drum buses, or for warmth in the lows with Warm mode.
use_for: Add air and presence per band with harmonics only, leaving the original signal untouched.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: The curve: Tape (tanh, odd harmonics), Tube (asymmetric, even and odd), Transistor (towards a hard clip), Diode (soft logarithmic, asymmetric), Warm (even harmonics only)
parameters.how: Chooses the curve that creates the added harmonics: Tape, Tube, Transistor, Diode or Warm.
parameters.sound: Tape and Tube sound smooth and rich, Transistor is bolder, Diode is edgy and Warm adds only even, full-sounding harmonics.

parameters.name: Drive
parameters.description: Gain into the shaper (before its output is brought back), 0.1 dB steps. More drive, more harmonics, higher orders
parameters.how: Raises the level into the harmonic generator by 0 to 36 dB.
parameters.sound: More drive creates more, and higher, harmonics for a brighter, more present sound.

parameters.name: Crossover 1
parameters.description: Between the first and the second band
parameters.how: Sets the frequency between the first and second band, from 20 Hz to 20 kHz.
parameters.sound: It decides where the lowest band, usually left alone, ends.

parameters.name: Crossover 2
parameters.description: Between the second and the third band (never below Crossover 1)
parameters.how: Sets the frequency between the second and third band.
parameters.sound: It moves the boundary between the lower and upper midrange for excitation.

parameters.name: Crossover 3
parameters.description: Between the third and the fourth band (never below Crossover 2)
parameters.how: Sets the frequency between the third and fourth band.
parameters.sound: It decides where the topmost band, which usually carries the air, begins.

parameters.name: Amount 1
parameters.description: How much of the first band's harmonics is added. 0 % leaves the band alone
parameters.how: Sets how much harmonic content is added to the first band, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: Above 0 the lows gain weight and warmth; at 0 they are left untouched.

parameters.name: Amount 2
parameters.how: Sets how much harmonic content is added to the second band.
parameters.sound: More adds body and warmth to the low midrange.

parameters.name: Amount 3
parameters.how: Sets how much harmonic content is added to the third band.
parameters.sound: More adds presence and bite to the upper midrange.

parameters.name: Amount 4
parameters.how: Sets how much harmonic content is added to the fourth band.
parameters.sound: More adds shine and air to the top end.

parameters.name: Shelf freq
parameters.description: The corner of the high shelf on the added harmonics
parameters.how: Sets the corner of a high shelf that shapes only the added harmonics, from 1 to 20 kHz.
parameters.sound: It decides where the added sparkle starts to be boosted or softened.

parameters.name: Shelf gain
parameters.description: The high shelf's gain on the added harmonics: brighter or duller excitation without touching the audio
parameters.how: Sets the high shelf's gain on the added harmonics, from -12 to +12 dB.
parameters.sound: Positive values make the excitation brighter, negative values make it duller, without changing the original audio.

parameters.name: Auto gain
parameters.description: Keeps the loudness: the output's level (300 ms) follows the input's, within ±6 dB
parameters.how: Keeps the loudness steady by following the input level within 6 dB.
parameters.sound: You hear the added brightness rather than a louder sound.

parameters.name: Stereo
parameters.description: What is excited: left and right, or mid and side (harmonics of the side widen, of the mid centre)
parameters.how: Chooses whether harmonics are added to left and right, or to mid and side.
parameters.sound: Mid/side adds harmonics to the sides to widen the sound, or to the centre to focus it.

parameters.name: Output
parameters.description: Gain after the exciter, 0.1 dB steps (the editor's Match sets it from the gain-match reading)
parameters.how: Adds -24 to +24 dB of gain after the exciter.
parameters.sound: It matches the loudness to the dry sound so you judge the added tone fairly.

parameters.name: Delta
parameters.description: Hear only what the exciter adds: the output minus the input, delayed to match (glides over 10 ms)
parameters.how: Plays only the difference between the output and the input.
parameters.sound: You hear only the harmonics that the exciter adds.

readings.description: Level of the added harmonics against the input (RMS, dB); −100 when nothing is added
Short-term loudness out − in (K-weighted, 3 s): what Output would have to take back for equal loudness
The oversampling's delay, constant, reported to NeoBuzz Live
